schema.rows: one per architecture, in drawing order
schema.rows[].architecture: key shared by the legacy and Tokamak-SI model
schema.rows[].legacy_model: published model scored on its own legacy target (null: none)
schema.rows[].tokamak_si_model: model scored on the Tokamak-SI labels (retrained twin or ours)
schema.rows[].legacy: f1_published_threshold (primary), f1_tuned (secondary), auroc, auprc, prevalence (beside AUPRC: it differs from the Tokamak-SI target), shots, bins, bin_ms (25), held_out
schema.rows[].tokamak_si: f1 (inner-validation threshold), auroc, auprc, prevalence, shots, bins, bin_ms (10), uncertain time excluded
schema.rows[].tokamak_si_uncertain_negative: the same with uncertain time scored as negative
schema.rows[].like_for_like: published model and retrained twin on one target, mask and shot set: primary and uncertain_negative, each with the published model at its published and tuned thresholds and the retrained model
schema.paired_common_shots: full_set (tm-ours and the two-line baseline, every development shot) and cnn_subset (tm-ours and the retrained CNN, the shots and bins where the CNN has inputs), each with a primary block (uncertain time excluded) and an uncertain_negative block; every block has the shots, bins, the models' metrics and the paired differences with their 95% intervals

ours.definition: labelled 10 ms bins from the measured plasma start to catalog window end; uncertain and unobservable bins excluded
ours.observable_definition: 10 ms plasma bins from the measured plasma start to catalog window end; uncertain included, unavailable excluded

ours_population.definition: labelled 10 ms bins from the measured plasma start to catalog window end; uncertain and unobservable bins excluded
ours_population.observable_definition: 10 ms plasma bins from the measured plasma start to catalog window end; uncertain included, unavailable excluded

legacy_seo.definition: matched growth-phase label support on observable catalog-window 10 ms bins; temporal holes excluded

legacy_survival.definition: survival-label support on observable catalog-window 10 ms bins; fixed-grid time outside observable plasma excluded

scope: development cohort and population excluding blind; common 10 ms catalog-window grid and observable plasma domain for both legacy and interval labels
threshold_policy: Legacy F1 at the model's published threshold (CNN 0.5, DSM risk 0.3) is primary and the inner-validation value secondary; Tokamak-SI F1 at positive-bearing presence-stratified inner-validation thresholds.
primary_comparison: AUROC and AUPRC, with prevalence beside AUPRC

paired_common_shots.policy: each comparison scores the shots and available 10 ms bins both of its models have, each model at its own fold thresholds, on one paired 1000-draw shot bootstrap; full_set (tm-ours, the two-line baseline tuned and at its seed levels) holds every development shot and is the set for any comparison with the baseline; cnn_subset (tm-ours, retrained CNN) is restricted to the shots and bins where the CNN has inputs and is used only for comparisons with the CNN; the uncertain_negative blocks score uncertain time as negative on the same scores and thresholds

training_size_confound.published_cnn_training_shots: not listed; the card reports a corpus of thousands of shots
training_size_confound.meaning: The published models were trained on thousands of shots; the retrained twins see about 324 per outer fold, so a retrained model that ranks below its published twin is confounded by training-set size. No population-scale retrain is part of this benchmark.

note: Legacy and Tokamak-SI targets differ in target, bin width, shot set, prevalence and mask, so no cross-setting gain is implied; the like-for-like pair scores a published model and its retrained twin on one target, one mask and one shot set. Null means no legacy model.
